_header: Auditing LLM Alpha-Factor Mining: Metric Provenance and Full-Cohort
Reanalysis -- Study Configuration
This file is the complete STUDY_CONFIG dictionary consumed by the
top-level orchestrator `run_study` (Task 14) of the implementation of
"Auditing LLM Alpha-Factor Mining: Metric Provenance and Full-Cohort
Reanalysis" by Yufeng He (2026). It is converted leaf for leaf from the
notebook's configuration literal: every section P00 to P45, the raw
input schemas and the verification targets.
Provenance tags (kept as trailing comments in config.yaml; taken from STUDY_CONFIG's parallel
"_provenance_tags" dictionary, which is data in the notebook):
• [S]   stated in the manuscript
• [D]   derived from, or implied by, the manuscript
• [R]   reproduction choice (may move published values; disclosed)
• [I]   illustrative only -- not in the manuscript; never a paper finding
• UNDISCLOSED  acknowledged absence in the manuscript
Conventions:
• Exponent floats are written as 1.0e-12 (YAML 1.1 reads 1e-12 as text).
• P42_ARITHMETIC_CLOSURES.sum_closures_rounds_to_totals is a Python set
in the notebook and is written here as a sorted JSON array (JSON has no set type).
• Published figures are comparison targets, never computed values.

Information destroyed at logging time is unrecoverable at analysis time.
